anatomy: Bulbous, grey-skinned head with multiple drooping facial tentacles; four-fingered hands with sharp, blackened nails; a long, segmented mollusc-like lower body
coloration: Dull slate grey skin with leathery texture; the lower body has a glossy, wet sheen; robes are a deep royal purple with golden embroidery
attire_and_adornment: Ornate, high-collared purple robes with blue bioluminescent inserts; a decorative silver circlet with a glowing blue gem is set into the forehead
posture_and_expression: Leaning over a technical console, hands poised to interact with a touchscreen; expression is focused and intensely analytical
distinctive_traits: The alien combines molluscoid facial features with a centauroid body plan, using the long tail for stability while working at high-tech stations
